correctness.rationale: A legal indicator word has <=1 marker, or equal marker spacing k>=2 with both end gaps <k. For n>=2 this yields exactly n+floor(n^2/4) binary words, each with q^n independent symbol lifts. Minimal forbidden indicators are 11 and, for each k>=2, 0^k10^(k-1)1 and 10^(k-1)10^k; their colored counts are q^2 or 2q^(2k+1). Each k>=2 component is a cyclic k-phase full q-shift with a unique Bernoulli maximal-entropy measure; the at-most-one-marker component contributes only the B full q-shift under invariant measures. Thus precisely countably many ergodic MME. Fixed points q^n sigma_1(n) and product zeta follow divisor sums. Independent enumeration of all binary words n=2..13 verified the exact word and minimal forbiddens; these scans are not a universal proof.
